scenes.label: Forest, midday
scenes.description: Soft canopy wind, scattered birds at distance, a slow creek behind it all.

scenes.label: Forest, night
scenes.description: Wind through dark canopy, a slow creek behind it. No birds.

scenes.label: Forest, evening rain
scenes.description: Light rain dripping from leaves at dusk, wind in the tree tops, a slow creek, quiet birds settling.

scenes.label: Rain on the window
scenes.description: Steady rain against glass, distant rain on pavement, a bass rumble miles off.

scenes.label: Monsoon
scenes.description: Heavy downpour on a metal roof, softer rain a little farther off, muffled thunder behind it all.

scenes.label: Ocean, at night
scenes.description: Surf rolling against a sand beach, crashing waves further out, the occasional distant shipyard across the bay.

scenes.label: Fireplace
scenes.description: Slow wood fire close at hand, a distant room-mic crackle behind it.
